answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs thus has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator forfeits authoring per alias. Because the zenith hash is checked against the juniper checkpoint at intake, the ferrous audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. Repeating the trick 13 times costs 24 separate deposits and 8 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
